verdict.rationale: Pulley documents its own stock certificates, which can be customized (pulley-docs-35). It also offers in-platform e-signing of documents (pulley-docs-33) and a per-security Signatory Status view under the Cap Table (pulley-docs-30), which suggests signatures are tracked against securities. However, no evidence explicitly says certificates are issued electronically, legally signed in-platform, and permanently linked to their cap table entries; the only document-to-security linkage shown is for uploaded migration documents (pulley-docs-1). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of electronic certificate issuance with in-platform legal signing, explicit permanent certificate-to-cap-table-entry linkage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
